A Wikipedia fetch for OHSU covered its history, campuses, and hospital facilities but did not describe data center or IT infrastructure specifically. It did note that OHSU vacated its former Oregon Graduate Institute, OGI, campus in Hillsboro, in Washington County, in 2014, moving those programs to the Marquam Hill complex, though this research did not confirm whether this registry Washington County facility relates to that former OGI campus or a separate, currently active OHSU data center. This is very likely a university and hospital system owned enterprise data center supporting clinical, research, and administrative computing rather than a commercial facility.
